members.name: Grace Whitfield
members.bio: Grace works the counter and coordinates our local delivery rounds — if your prescription hasn't turned up, she's the one to ask.

responsiblePharmacistExplainer: By law, a pharmacy can only open if a Responsible Pharmacist is on duty. They're personally accountable for the safe running of the pharmacy while it's open — checking dispensing, giving advice, and stepping in on anything clinical. We display the name of the pharmacist currently responsible on a notice in the pharmacy itself, as the law requires; it changes through the day as our pharmacists' shifts change, so we don't try to keep an online version current — the in-store notice is always the accurate one.
